b: Totally Wycked Audio (TWA) has unveiled the Better Box, a clean harmonic booster designed to act like a "secret sauce" by adding girth, richness, and dimension to your sound – without changing your core guitar tone.

Designed by Tube Screamer creator Susumu Tamura, and hand made in the USA, the TWA BB-01 Better Box enhances harmonic content without distorting the input signal. The BB-01 adds harmonic overtones to give your instrument a thicker, slightly rounder, more tube-like character while maintaining clarity and note definition. It imparts a unique harmonic signature that emphasizes even-order multiples of the fundamental being played, with a light dusting of specific odd-order harmonics in the upper registers to add just the right amount of sonic spice.

Its user-friendly control set includes just two knobs that will immediately improve your guitar tone. The “Better” knob adjusts even/odd harmonic content. The “Louder” knob control adjusts output level. Simple, straightforward – and ideal for onstage or in the studio.

Designed by the legendary Susumu Tamura, creator of the Tube Screamer
Generates increased even & odd order harmonic content without distortion
Improves sonic clarity and psychoacoustic character of any instrument
Evens out overall frequency response and creates punchy, tight pick attack
Can be used to push amplifier input and/or drive long signal chains
Functions as harmonic enhancer, level booster (+16 dB max), compressor, and/or preamp
True bypass switching, pedalboard friendly top-mounted jacks
9-volt external DC power operation – no battery compartment
The TWA BB-01 Better Box is available for a street price of $249. For more information visit www.godlyke.com.
